title: leonurus glabra
intro: Leonurus glabra, commonly known as White Hedeoma or Smooth Hedge Bedstraw, is a flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The bioactive constituents of Leonurus glabra include diterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Leonurus glabra have been attributed to its ability to relax the nervous system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity.
